messages:
Diego V: hey all, first day here. tried to open the inference dashboards but the region templating variable is empty (no regions to select) so panels show no series. Grafana returns a small yellow banner: 'No data for the selected time range'. Also Datadog Log Explorer opens but shows zero logs for inference-prod (no 403, just empty). Sentry link for inference-runtime leads to a 403. my okta is diego.v@redwood.ai

devex-bot: welcome @Diego V! please paste your email and which dashboards/projects you need. docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/observability-onboard. If you want quicker help tag @Infra Observability. :wave:

Kara S: welcome Diego! region variable empty usually means the provisioning that seeds dashboard provisioning variables didn't run for your account or your data role lacks index read. for Sentry 403 that's likely a missing project invite. i'll start by checking your Okta groups and kick a SCIM sync.

Diego V: thanks Kara 1 email above. curious about dashboard variables because i can see the dashboard metadata but the drop-down is blank.

Kara S: can you open the dashboard settings -> Variables and confirm the query source? if it's using a datasource query (e.g., ${regions:query}) it needs the datasource role to run the query. if it's a JSON file backed variable, the provisioning job populates it. small checklist: 1) try incognito, 2) check Okta group membership, 3) i'll kick SCIM.

Diego V: incognito same. Okta shows me in redwood-engineers but not in redwood-observability (huh).

Kara S: that explains a lot. i've queued a SCIM provisioning sync for diego.v@redwood.ai and will add redwood-observability so you get grafana-viewers and the Datadog index-read mapping.

Grafana Bot: Provisioning job queued for diego.v@redwood.ai (job id: 2026-03-23-provision-1923456789). Will apply grafana-viewers and refresh dashboard variables cache.

Kara S: for Datadog, can you run a quick API check to see if the token can list indexes? replace token from the vault:

```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}"
  -H "DD-API-KEY: <workspace-token>"
  "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/logs/config/indexes"
```

If that returns 200 you can list indexes; if 403 then role mapping didn't apply.

Diego V: returns 403 for the indexes endpoint. interesting that log explorer UI opened but just empty.

Infra Observability: saw the SCIM sync start and noticed Okta had not included redwood-observability in Diego's profile due to a missing groups claim mapping. i've manually added the group in Okta and will also force a provisioning write to Grafana and Datadog. re-check in ~90s.

Diego V: re-ran the curl after about 2m and now it returns 200. the Grafana region variable repopulated and panels show series 389. Sentry still 403 though.

Kara S: Sentry project invite is owner-controlled. infra-observability is not automatically added to project-level Sentry; i'll look up the project owner and request an invite for diego.v@redwood.ai. meanwhile, small FYI: dashboard variables are provisioned from the terraform-backed dashboards repo (repos/infra/grafana/provisioned), so if you want a new static region added we accept PRs there.

Infra Observability: sent a Sentry invite to diego.v@redwood.ai for inference-runtime-prod (owner accepted invite). you should be good now. also added diego.v@redwood.ai to grafana-viewers and datadog-index-read.

Diego V: Sentry invite arrived and accepted, can see recent errors. thanks! quick question: i want to add p95/p99 lines and a templated panel that switches between region and deployment (we use templating heavily). who owns the dashboard and the workflow for changes?

Kara S: dashboards are owned by infra-observability. small edits (visuals, adding p95/p99, adding variable queries) are normally done by opening a PR in repos/infra/grafana/provisioned or via the Grafana UI and then exporting JSON into the repo. alert threshold or index/ingest changes require approval from infra-observability + SRE. If you want temporary grafana-editor to prototype, request it here and we'll grant for a few hours.

Diego V: can i get grafana-editor for 3h to prototype the variable and p99 lines? i'll export JSON and open a PR for review before merging.

Infra Observability: granted temporary grafana-editor to diego.v@redwood.ai for 3h. note: if you change variable queries that pull from Datadog, run the dashboard in preview to ensure no extra API load during business hours.

Diego V: awesome 44d i'll prototype and open a PR in repos/infra/grafana/provisioned with the exported JSON and a short rationale about why p99 helps with tail latency. appreciate the fast help everyone :heart:

Kara S: welcome aboard and glad it's resolved. we'll add a short note to the onboarding doc about the 'groups claim' edge case so future hires don't hit this. closing the loop.

Grafana Bot: Provisioning job completed successfully for diego.v@redwood.ai (job id: 2026-03-23-provision-1923456789).
